name: USB Adapter
notes: Has no SET button: start linking from software with Start ALL-Linking (0x64).
Reaches powerline devices only through a dual-band device, such as an Access Point or LampLinc Dual Band.
Has no X10: it answers Send X10 (0x63) with a NAK, and never sends X10 Received (0x52).
The USB Adapter Developer Notes say it uses the PowerLinc USB 2414U's protocol, but the commands they name are the PowerLinc Modem's.
